findings.finding: Full V2-06 remains FAIL. Hosted Chrome project creation cannot pass the client checksum stage in the connected session because the selected file bytes are not readable; Windows pairing, second-account live isolation, hosted ASR/render parity, native offline/reconnect/cancel/stale-lease/update/reboot/sleep recovery, durable Workflow recovery, explicit output deletion, live backup/restore, rollback exercise, and billing observation also remain unproven. The exact-HEAD redeploy updated the Worker but Wrangler exited 1 on a Cloudflare internal Workflow-trigger update error; the existing Workflow remains listed and public status is HTTP 200.

Provider-free tests, the public status contract, and the seeded catalog do not prove hosted non-superuser RLS under both identities, full private R2 transfer/commit, ASR/render output parity, or recovery behavior.

Rollback and restore remain available as documented procedures but were not live-exercised against the current 6336a75 deployment; the Workflow trigger update also returned a Cloudflare internal error during the exact-HEAD redeploy and was not retried.
